BiblicalUsage: Shubah is a return, and it appears once, in the word that has steadied me more than any other: in returning and rest shall ye be saved, in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. The Lord offered it, and the people would not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe return is the whole gospel in one word, because God asked not for striving but for coming back and resting in quietness and confidence.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
